content: Cloud Run WebSockets: subject to request timeout (default 5 min, max 60 min) even if app has no timeout; clients must reconnect. Do not enable HTTP/2 end-to-end with WebSockets. Session affinity is best effort. Up to 1000 concurrent connections per instance. Any open WebSocket keeps the instance active and billed. Multi-instance state must be synced via external store (Redis Pub/Sub). Verified against docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/triggering/websockets.
